observations.start: Captain Harlan outside the Lumbridge General Store
observations.reported_choice: Magic gear: staff, 40 air runes and 40 mind runes, based on a November 2026 player report.
observations.model: The first claim requires quest completion and starts the shared cooldown. A return claim requires the first claim and the elapsed cooldown, and restarts that timer.

observations.start: Farmer Bea's Digsite hives and adjacent Hunter field
observations.prerequisite: The Birds and the Wasps completed; unlock.beas_hunter_field set at quest completion
observations.bag_contents: Random low-level supplies are not added to the route as guaranteed resources.

observations.prerequisite: Death on the Isle complete (including base 34 Thieving)
stages: Open fancy chest in the southern wine cellar
Use icon on Statue of Ates north of Aldarin market
observations.reward: Enable the North Aldarin destination. The statue drops one collectible water rune.
observations.teleport_rule: Each teleport requires a charged, untradeable pendant and consumes one charge. The pendant comes from a conditional post-quest Amoxliatl drop. Five frozen tears have a modeled Grand Exchange budget of 1,500 GP.

The first wasp dart action awards its single 5 XP; add a training-aware XP model before using these actions for XP optimization.
